basic_info.description: Charming Outer Richmond Home with Partial Ocean Views! This beautifully refreshed home features a newer roof (2023), new interior and exterior paint, new windows, and refinished/new hardwood floors. The original kitchen and split bath offer a fantastic opportunity for customization. The property also includes a new garage door with a LiftMaster automatic opener, remotes, and keypad for added convenience. The main level boasts three light filled bedrooms, including one with a private deck overlooking the backyard. Buyer to verify intended use with an engineer/architect. Elegant crown molding, inviting living and dining areas, and a cozy wood-burning fireplace enhance the home’s charm. The gated front entry, generous backyard, full basement, and two-car garage with a full driveway provide ample space and flexibility. Located in the vibrant Richmond District, this home is just a short walk to public transportation on Geary and Balboa, with easy access to restaurants, cafés, shopping, and San Francisco landmarks like Golden Gate Park, Ocean Beach, Sutro Heights, Seal Rocks, and Lands End. Don't miss this incredible opportunity to own a classic Richmond gem!  OPEN HOUSES SAT-SUN, 4/12 & 4/13 1-4 PM
